initial_state: Saved accepted poses and incoming priors from assets/depth-convergence-v1/summary.json
data_role: already viewed development; local refinement only
association: Select reciprocal pairs once at initial poses; admit at least200 samples per raw pair; preserve exact measured points/normals
linearization: Recompute rotating symmetric-normal residual/Jacobian, Huber weights, transported nonlinear prior, H/g at every inner pose
solve: Original scaled positive definite Cholesky, condition<=1e6; no damping, pseudoinverse or rank fill
search: Original eight Armijo lengths1..1/128 on the same frozen Huber-plus-prior objective
final_checks: Separate fixed-population and fresh-population equations, spectral conditions and remaining unscaled corrections; fixed convergence is not fresh convergence
comparison: Same initial poses and prior; control is the previously archived ten fresh-association continuation updates
progression_rule: Advance to full trajectories only if BOTH cases improve fresh-converged count, have no fixed/fresh guard failures, pass all fresh RMS<=0.03m gates, and have fresh median RMS no worse than the archived control
